runs.name: Payload Protection Azure
runs.display_title: test(testing): cover story 16.3 review fixes for preflight diagnostics

head_commit.message:
test(testing): cover story 16.3 review fixes for preflight diagnostics

Add an owning test that DaprReadModelStoreDecorator forwards every
interface DaprReadModelStore implements, so a new optional capability
cannot be silently dropped behind a fixture's injected failure.

Cover the RequireDaprExecutable branch for a bare executable name that
is absent from PATH, the fallback ConversationGatewayLiveFixture takes
without ~/.dapr/bin/daprd.

Widen the 100/150 ms readiness budgets in the stable-diagnostic tests
to 2 s with 25 ms retry intervals so they cannot expire before the
first in-process response on a slow host.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(ci): restore current tuple after companion merges

A /pushall merged the retired tuple-legacy and tuple-pre-extension
companion branches (cd0b1aa1, 9dd73bea, 3cd9a77b, 5691d313), reverting
main to the Builds 4.45.0 tuple. Restore the exact 73fef1d0 tree: Builds
6.0.5 binding, owner gitlinks, package provenance and tool manifest.
The companion branches are merged and pruned, so they cannot recur.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
